name: confetti

frames.best_why: A wide spray of coloured paper fills the stage while both trigger buttons stay readable.

tagline: Coloured paper erupts from the button you click and rains down the screen.
summary: A full-screen canvas that shoots paper confetti from the middle of whichever button is pressed. Two presets fire different bursts: a broad multicoloured one and a narrower red, orange and yellow one.
appearance: A near-black stage holds a faint grey hint line and two small white rounded buttons, one reading a party emoji plus Confetti and one a fire emoji plus Fire. Once fired, tiny coloured rectangles and streamers scatter across the whole frame, densest at the button and thinning as they fall.
behaviour: Nothing moves until a button is pressed, then paper bursts out of that button's centre with a spread and speed set per button, tumbles under gravity and fades. The two buttons differ in colour palette and spray width.
demo_content: "Click to burst" hint and buttons labelled with a party emoji plus Confetti and a fire emoji plus Fire
search_phrases: shoot paper from the clicked button
celebrate a signup with falling paper
use_when: A success moment such as a signup, payment or completed task deserves a short, non-blocking celebration.
avoid_when: Busy dashboards or repeated triggers: full-screen flying paper pulls attention off the task.
customise: Each burst takes an options object for colours, spread, starting speed and particle count; canvas size, manual start and global options are props too.
weight_why: A canvas particle burst for a few seconds while firing, idle the rest of the time.

a11y.note: Both triggers are real buttons, but the canvas has no aria-hidden and the burst is purely visual.

issues: The "Click to burst" hint is tiny, low-contrast grey on black.
polish_why: Bursts look convincing and distinct; the bare demo stage and faint hint hold it back.
